DOWNFALL-ATTACK_SLIME.title: Bruiser Slime
DOWNFALL-ATTACK_SLIME.description:
Deals [blue]3[/blue] damage twice to a random enemy at the start of your turn.
[gold]Absorb[/gold]: Gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
DOWNFALL-ATTACK_SLIME.smartDescription:
Deals [blue]{Passive}[/blue] damage twice to a random enemy at the start of your turn.
[gold]Absorb[/gold]: Gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
DOWNFALL-POISON_SLIME.title: Guerilla Slime
DOWNFALL-POISON_SLIME.description:
